findings.description: Added top-heavy NDCG/listwise oracle ranking support and two safe configs.
Added CQL-style conservative q oracle loss and one safe config.
Added greedy ensemble lower-confidence-bound rerank support and q/reward LCB script variants.
Changed non-target dev default to protocol-safe subckt_0001 and added BENCH preflight.
Added candidate-context oracle loss, context planner score fields, q/reward context safe configs, and context script variants.
Changed oracle loading to skip forbidden benchmark rows such as subckt_0001 while keeping forbidden groups out of training.

config.goal: Improve world-model rerank using NDCG/listwise, conservative/uncertainty, candidate-context, or DAG-aware methods without using the 8 target circuits for training, calibration, or model selection.
config.verify: run non-target dev rerank and print best delta TC %
